pillars.name: Banquet Tradition
pillars.description: Serving meals on fresh banana leaves during festivals and weddings reflects deep-rooted principles of sustainability and warm hospitality (Virundhombal).

scale_visual_prompt.subject: Traditional South Indian Virundhu (feast) served elaborate vegetarian dishes laid out systematically on a fresh, vibrant green banana leaf.
scale_visual_prompt.composition: Top-down flat lay view, symmetrical framing capturing the banana leaf centered with organized portions of rice, sambhar, vathal kuzhambu, poriyal, kootu, payasam, appalam, and pickles.
scale_visual_prompt.action: Warm steam gently rising off freshly served rice, with a traditional brass sombu pouring water into a tumbler nearby.
scale_visual_prompt.location: A festive wedding hall (Kalyana Mandapam) setup in Tamil Nadu, with smooth polished teak tables and traditional brassware.
scale_visual_prompt.aesthetic: Authentic, warm, and inviting ambiance with rich organic greens, deep metallic brass tones, and natural soft morning sunlight.

pillars.name: Flavors
pillars.description: From authentic South Indian filter coffee served in a traditional dabara set to traditional vegetarian tiffins (Idli, Dosa, Sambhar, Pongal) and flavorful regional spices.

scale_visual_prompt.subject: Steaming hot South Indian filter coffee being poured into a polished brass dabara set, alongside a traditional tiffin platter of crispy ghee roast dosa, pillowy soft idlis, and roasted chana dal chutney.
scale_visual_prompt.composition: Close-up macro shot with shallow depth of field, focusing sharply on the frothy coffee foam pouring mid-air from cup to dabara vessel.
scale_visual_prompt.action: A skilled artisan high-pour creating a rich, thick froth layer in the coffee, capturing dynamic movement and steam bubbles.
scale_visual_prompt.location: A classic traditional South Indian tiffin house with brass lamps and wooden elements.
scale_visual_prompt.aesthetic: Rustic yet refined, dominated by warm golden hues, rich coffee brown tones, and comforting rustic textures.
